value.answer: Depends which football you mean. For soccer I'd say Messi. Most coverage has him as the greatest, his 2026 World Cup run pushed him further ahead in the debate, and he has 8 Ballon d'Or to Ronaldo's 5. For NFL it's still Brady with 7 Super Bowl wins, though Mahomes is the one closing in and fans are split.
